note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 181 green-belt boundaries and describes them as land designated by local planning authorities for planning purposes, with current entity records exposing exact references and local-authority-district identifiers and authoritative quality. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round63 remote checkpoint/readback still exposes no authoritative green-belt reference, green-belt-core, local-authority-district identifier, organisation identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate boundary to this fixed slot. Choosing one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
